rows.note: Use 一眼 as the all-purpose everyday noun for a brief, incomplete look.

example.english: I only got a glimpse of the photo.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 mong6 zo2 fuk1 soeng2 jat1 ngaan5

rows.note: Use 印象 when the glimpse means a faint or vague impression rather than a visual look.

example.english: I only have a vague glimpse of what happened.
example.traditional: 我對件事只有個模糊印象。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gin6 si6 zi2 jau5 go3 mou4 wu4 jan3 zoeng6

rows.note: Use 頭緒 when the inkling is a tentative lead or partial understanding of how something fits together.

example.english: This pile of information finally gave me a glimpse of how everything fits together.
example.traditional: 呢堆資料終於畀我搵到少少頭緒。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi1 zi1 liu6 zung1 jyu1 bei2 ngo5 wan2 dou2 siu2 siu2 tau4 seoi5
